cohort: 91,662 women with singleton live births in Arkansas (including 2488 Marshallese women)
finding: Marshallese women and infants experienced higher rates of adverse perinatal outcomes compared to NH White women and infants.
mod_finding: Marshallese women had higher rates of forceps (PR = 1.68; 95% CI 1.16, 2.43) or vacuum (PR = 1.89; 95% CI 1.60, 2.22) use during delivery compared to NH White women.
